title: Area 51 caller: extradimensional beings contacted by early space program

tellings.quote: Okay. Um um Okay. what what we're thinking of as as aliens are. They're uh they're they're extradimensional beings that [laughter] an earlier precursor of the um space program made contact with.

plain: The beings we call aliens are really "extradimensional beings" that an early forerunner of the space program made contact with, according to a man who called the late-night radio show Coast to Coast AM in 1997, hosted by Art Bell, saying he had worked at Area 51, the secret test site in Nevada. The call comes up on Michels's show in a talk with the hip hop artist Flying Lotus, and the caller, who sounds nervous and stumbling, presents it as something he knew from inside.
